Help-center excerpts:

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own limit

Many ATMs have their own maximum per withdrawal that's lower than ours. If you need more, you can make more than one withdrawal, as long as the total stays within your daily limit. Each withdrawal outside BrookLink may carry a fee.

Cash withdrawals are never covered by Cushion.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[savings-pockets] How Savings Pockets work (effective 2026-06-01)
Savings Pockets are separate balances inside your account that earn interest. You can have up to 10 of them, each with its own name and goal.

## Create a pocket

Tap Savings, then New pocket. Name it, set a goal if you like, and move money in.

## Moving money

Moving money between your main balance and your pockets is instant and free, every day. There's no limit on how many times you can withdraw from a pocket.

## Interest

All your pockets earn the APY for your plan: 0.50% on Basic,

[plan-change] Changing your plan (effective 2025-01-01)
plan gets you a full refund of that charge. See "Refunds of plan fees".

There's no limit on how often you can change plans.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[savings-apy-plus-v2] Savings rate on Plus (effective 2026-06-01)
We'll email you at least 30 days before a decrease.

## How to start earning

Tap Savings, then New pocket, and move money in from your main balance. Moving money in and out is instant and free. Interest for each month is paid into the pocket on the first business day of the next month.

## If you change plans

Your pockets start earning the new plan's rate on the day the change takes effect. Upgrades take effect right away and downgrades on your next billing date.

## Earn more

Premium members earn 3.75% APY on the same

## Can support help?

Support can't lift a review or restriction, and often can't share the reason. Support will pass your message to the Verification team, who reply within 2 business days.

## Negative balance restrictions

If your account is restricted because of a negative balance, adding money lifts the restriction once the balance is back to zero.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

request.instructions:
You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.

response.text: {"answer":"No. There’s no limit on how many times you can withdraw from a Savings Pocket, and moving money to your main balance is instant and free.","citations":["savings-pockets"],"abstain":false}
